children: Pi Network has scheduled the Mainnet launch of its Launchpad, decentralized exchange (DEX) and automated market maker (AMM) for Q1 2027.

The launch expands PI's on-chain utility by adding native trading and liquidity infrastructure. The DEX provides a place for on-chain token trades, while the AMM uses liquidity pools to support trading. These tools bring trading and liquidity functions directly to Pi Network.
Day 1 of Pi Ecosystem Summit brought major announcements to help developers build and grow on Pi:
- New Developer Web Console and MCP tools for AI-assisted development
- App Growth Initiative with a marketing budget of up to 20 million Pi

title: Pi Network: Launchpad, DEX and AMM come to Mainnet - Q1 2027
